craft_notes: Sthāyin vismaya at measurelessness. Dash moved to line-1 end holds both comparatives; colon lands line 2 on the epithet. Rejected: 'atom and Alp' rhyme — slant needs new doctrine; dropped (subset rule). Read aloud: both, Pillar.

lines: Finer than the sacred-syllable half-mora crown, to mote and mountain both —
wider than the world-egg: hail the traitless-traited, the Pillar.
l4.sanskrit_cite: praṇavordhvārdhamātrāto 'py aṇave mahate punaḥ brahmāṇḍād api nairguṇyaguṇāya sthāṇave namaḥ

reads_against.argmap: Than praṇava's upper half-mora even, to the minute, again to the great. → Bow to Sthāṇu beyond measure, minute and great, qualified by qualitylessness.
c1_essence: Sthāṇu beyond minute and great; goose-power praised; groundless world-picture bowed.
reads_against.c1_rasa: bhakti-vismaya (devotion charged with wonder); sthayibhava utsāha-in-bhakti

l2.plain_english: Subtler than praṇava's upper half-mora — to the minute, and again to the great; vaster than the world-egg — to the qualified-by-qualitylessness, to Sthāṇu: bow.
